The identity v−(1+u)⁻¹=(z−1)/[(1+zu)(1+u)] bounds the error uniformly in u, with v≤2 for small h. By 0≤y−log(1+y)≤y²/2, the numerical and shadow exponents differ at all mesh times by at most Tκ|z−1|+2Tκ²h. Terminal evaluation at T>0 is injective in q for a,κ>0, proving necessity of q→1 and thus hα→0.
